Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 148 s. 2022 22 202). Hon. EDUARDO B. GADIANO Governor, Province of Occidental Mindoro Provincial Capitol Compound Barangay Payompon Mamburao, Occidental Mindoro Dear Governor Gadiano: This refers to your letter dated 10 February 2022 (Letter) requesting from the Department a legal opinion on the following queries: I. Does the Sangguniang Panlalawigan have the authority to disapprove the Local Expenditure Program as submitted by the Local Chief Executive? 2. If the Sanggunian has such authority, can it disapprove the proposed 2022 Local Expenditure Program (LEP) in its entirety despite the fact that based on Sanggunian findings, there are only some items in the proposed LEP whose allocations are found inconsistent with the FY 2022 Annual Investment Program? 3. Is it proper for the Sanggunian, at this point, to decide to re-enact the 2021 annual and supplemental budgets, to hold sessions until an appropriation ordinance is approved as mandated by Section 323 of the Local Government Code? 4. Was the abrupt disapproval of the 2022 Local Expenditure Program proper especially in the light of this year's initial implementation of the national government's devolved functions to local government units? Under a re- enacted budget, the increase in national tax allocation (formerly, internal revenue allotment) cannot be utilized and no new positions can be created and filled up. Your Letter was indorsed to this office by Dir. Wilhelm B. Suyco, Regional Director, DILG Region IV-B MIMAROPA for appropriate action . As to your first, second and fourth queries, DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2022- 0041 states, in part, that the "(T)he Sanggunian with the assistance of the Local Finance Committee (LFC), shall evaluate and deliberate on the Local Expenditure Program (LEP) in terms of compliance with the budqetary requirements and general limitations. " (Emphasis Supplied) 1 Entitled "Supplemental Advisory to the DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2021-109 and Additional Guidance on Local Annual Budget Authorization." "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

Based on the aforequoted provision of DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2022-004, the sanggunian, with the assistance of the Local Finance Committee (LFC), shall evaluate and deliberate on the Local Expenditure Program (LEP) in terms of compliance with the budgetary requirements and general limitations. Since the concerned Sanggunian is mandated to evaluate and deliberate the LEP, it follows that it also has the authority to disapprove the LEP both on a per item basis and in its entirety, provided however that said august body indicates in a clear manner the reason/s for such disapproval (e.g. non-compliance with the approved Local Revenue Code) so that the local chief executive shall thereafter be guided on what to do. We note that the SP listed at least fourteen (14) reasons in its Resolution justifying its conclusion that the 2022 LEP you have submitted is questionable, irregular, and out of order. Hence, its denial by the collegial body. As represented, the SP even promulgated and transmitted to your Office a certain Resolution No. 9, series of 2022 which contains the recommendations for consideration and the appropriate adjustments to the LEP. As to the it may be worthy to note that your good Office is asking whether it is proper for the Sanggunianto decide to re-enact the 2021 annual and supplemental budgets. Based on Section 323 of RA 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991, the ordinance authorizing the appropriations of the preceding year shall be deemed reenacted and shall remain in force and effect until the ordinance authorizing the proposed appropriations is passed by the Sanggunian concerned. Thus, the re- enactment of the appropriations ordinance of the previous year applies by operation of law and therefore, there is no need for the concerned sanggunian to adopt a resolution to re-enact the same. Such automatic re-enactment of the appropriations ordinance of the previous year has the purpose of relieving the concerned sanggunian of still passing a measure to this effect. We are aware that passing a legislative measure entails a certain period of time. This period could still be used by the august body to carry out its more urgent mandate, that is, to conduct/hold sessions without additional remuneration to enact the appropriations ordinance. This opinion is rendered based on the facts provided, and is issued without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have sufficiently addressed your concerns. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AU ORITY OF THE SECRETARY: AN VICTOR R.
